answer: The oasis register is checked at draw time, quartz lists the eligible set, and juniper seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 83 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 83 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 31 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
